notes.subject: ruak
notes.rationale: ורוחו i ruak — win/Spirit/pulim win, wanpela tok tpi; 'breath' long KJV i husim dispela

notes.subject: בנפת שוא
notes.rationale: sain bilong pairapsem (pairapsem olgeta) o sain bilong we nating — ol tanima i no wankain

notes.subject: מתעה
notes.rationale: resen i makim ol i go long raun (kaus bilong go stret i lus) o resen we Yahwe i usim long makim ol manmeri i go long rong pasin

notes.subject: נפת/הנפה
notes.rationale: הנפה (tu-skelim/selim) na נפת (sain) — olgeta i klostu wankain long nois, i lus long Tok Pisin

translation: Na ruak bilong ⟨em⟩ i olsem wanpela wara i pulapela i go antap, i go long nek, i sotim ⟨i⟩ long tupela hap, long skelim olgeta ol kantri wantaim wanpela sain bilong we nating; na wanpela resen i long mak bilong sanguma long maun bilong ol manmeri, i pulim ol i go long raun.

tokens.gloss: i olsem wanpela wara i pulapela
